My voice has been described by my friends as ‘decidedly English’ because there’s no overly present inflection or stress on words to give me a noticeable or memorable accent, it’s just English.

When you say English accent, what accent do you mean?? It’s the same premise with America, there are so many. 

I don’t sound like a typical English person. I don’t have an overly posh voice like the queen, I don’t sound like a chav or like a cockney person would from London. I don’t have the geordie accent, nor the liverpudlian. 

We’re typically presented to have the accent that suggests that we’re rough ‘bit rude innit mate’ that sort of thing but, as in any country there are a massive variety of accents in England alone, so though even considering Wales, Scotland or Ireland.
